name: shell-quality
description: Makes every shell script Claude edits pass shfmt and ShellCheck. A plugin hook formats each .sh and .bash file with the shfmt and checks it with the ShellCheck already installed in your project or globally, using your own .shellcheckrc and .editorconfig; asks you before Claude adds a suppression directive or changes that configuration; and keeps Claude working, up to 7 attempts, until the scripts it touched are clean. Its skill teaches Claude to install, configure, run, integrate and fix findings with both tools from the official documentation.

enabled.title: Shell hook
enabled.description: On: after each edit Claude makes to a .sh or .bash file, the hook formats it with shfmt and checks it with ShellCheck, and keeps Claude working until it passes. Off: the hooks do nothing; the skill stays available.
